summary: Code review of bug fixes for 'Sketch Notes' feature in React Native/Expo roofing app. Bug Fix 1 (notes in PDF) verified correct in code. Bug Fix 2 (button wrapping) was incomplete - applied additional style fix (flex: 1, minWidth).
action_items: Verify on actual iPad that notes modal buttons display correctly without text wrapping after the applied style fix
Verify sketch notes appear in PDF preview/export by creating a sketch with notes and generating PDF
critical_code_review_comments: Bug Fix 1 (Notes in PDF): VERIFIED CORRECT - The Sketch interface in projects/[id].tsx now includes 'notes' and 'pdf_size' fields. PDF generation code at lines 850-895 correctly reads sketch.notes with fallback to metadata.notes.

Bug Fix 2 (Button Styles): IMPROVED - Original fix added styles but was missing 'flex: 1' and 'minWidth: 80' which are present in other modal buttons. Applied additional fix to prevent text wrapping on iPad.
Data Flow Verification: LocalStorage.ts Sketch interface (line 330) has notes field. draw.tsx correctly saves notes to sketch object (lines 1059-1079) and saves to metadata as fallback (line 1017).

success_rate.frontend: 90% - code review passed, limited E2E testing due to React Native/Expo constraints

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a React Native/Expo app, not a standard web app. Sketch drawing features and PDF generation are best tested on actual iPad device. The notes modal styles were enhanced with flex: 1 and minWidth: 80 to prevent button text wrapping.

bug1_notes_in_pdf.root_cause: Sketch interface in projects/[id].tsx was missing 'notes' and 'pdf_size' fields, causing TypeScript to not recognize these properties when reading sketch data for PDF generation.
bug1_notes_in_pdf.fix_applied: Added 'notes?: string' and 'pdf_size?: string' to Sketch interface at lines 83-84
bug1_notes_in_pdf.verification: Code review confirms PDF generation at lines 853-866 correctly reads sketch.notes with metadata.notes fallback

bug2_button_wrapping.root_cause: notesModalButton style was missing 'flex: 1' property that other modal buttons have, causing buttons to size based on content which could lead to text wrapping on narrow containers
bug2_button_wrapping.fix_applied_by_main_agent: Added new style definitions for notesModalButtons, notesModalButton, notesModalButtonSave, etc.
bug2_button_wrapping.additional_fix_applied_by_testing_agent: Added 'flex: 1' and 'minWidth: 80' to notesModalButton style to match other modal button styles and prevent text wrapping

testing_limitations: React Native/Expo app with sketch drawing is designed for mobile/tablet (iPad). Web browser automation has limited ability to test touch-based drawing features and modals. Full verification requires testing on actual iPad device.
